candidates.mechanism: Distance pairs and ratio pairs: (a) z-normalise each leg's last 30 daily closes, spread = n1 - n2, enter when the spread is beyond 2 std of its window, exit within 0.5 std, 10-day time stop, 5% stop; (b) cu-al-spread: z of the contract-value ratio over 30 days, threshold 2, exit |z|<0.5 -- but the source goes LONG the rich leg (z>2 -> long Cu, short Al), i.e. ratio MOMENTUM, the opposite of (a).
candidates.title: XBRUSD relative_value (QR-A-TQ-006)
candidates.falsifier: neither sign positive on any pair
